title: File the annual unclaimed property holder report (New Jersey)
description: Businesses holding property that has gone unclaimed — uncashed payroll or vendor checks, customer credits and refunds, unused gift cards, deposits — must report and turn it over to the state each year, after sending the owner a due diligence notice before the deadline. The annual report and payment are due November 1 for general property. A negative report is recommended. Which state's law applies depends on the owner's last known address, or the business's state of incorporation when there is none, so a business can owe reports to several states.

feeDetail.note: There is no fee to file or register.

title: Classify contractors with the ABC test before treating workers as independent (New Jersey)
authority: New Jersey Department of Labor and Workforce Development
description: New Jersey applies the ABC test to wage, hour and unemployment law. Failing any prong makes the worker an employee, with back contributions and per-worker penalties. One source says new misclassification regulations take effect October 1, 2026; check the Department of Labor.

feeDetail.note: There is no fee; this is a contracting requirement.
